metadata.title: TinyWarden
metadata.description: Self-hosted health and maintenance for Linux fleets.

home.title: A clearer view of your Linux fleet.
home.description: TinyWarden is being built to help you understand which hosts need attention and why.
home.notice: Use the dashboard to view enrolled hosts. This page does not show live fleet data.
home.footer: Open source. Self-hosted. Built for hosts wherever they run.

reasons.execution_mismatch: Execution evidence did not match the recipe.
reasons.execution_failed: The observation command failed or exited unexpectedly.
reasons.execution_timed_out: The observation exceeded its time budget.
reasons.execution_policy_rejected: The agent rejected execution under its local policy.
reasons.execution_spawn_failed: The approved observation tool could not be started.
reasons.runner_busy: The agent is finishing another observation.
reasons.output_unsupported: Command output could not be interpreted reliably.
reasons.clock_uncertain: The observation clock could not be verified.
reasons.boot_uncertain: The boot identity changed or could not be verified during observation.
reasons.package_changes: The cached package plan contains upgrades, new dependencies or held-back packages.
reasons.package_removals: The cached package plan includes removals that need attention.
reasons.package_cache_unverified: The cached plan contains no changes; repository freshness and local-state consistency remain unverified.
reasons.reboot_marker_present: A package has left a reboot-required marker.
reasons.reboot_assurance_unverified: No reboot marker was observed; other reboot needs remain unverified.
reasons.fstrim_unit_unavailable: The fstrim timer or service is unavailable.
reasons.fstrim_timer_disabled: The fstrim timer is disabled or masked.
reasons.fstrim_timer_failed: The fstrim timer is in a failed state.
reasons.fstrim_condition_skipped: A systemd condition skipped the timer or service.
reasons.fstrim_history_unavailable: No completed fstrim service history is available.
reasons.fstrim_running: The timer or service is still running or changing state.
reasons.fstrim_service_failed: The fstrim service reports a failed run.
reasons.fstrim_schedule_unverified: The next fstrim schedule could not be verified.
reasons.fstrim_condition_unverified: Evaluated systemd condition history is unavailable.
reasons.fstrim_trigger_unconfirmed: The latest timer trigger has no confirmed completed service run.
reasons.fstrim_observed_success: The timer is scheduled and a completed fstrim service reported success; reclaimed space is unverified.
reasons.unsupported_observation: The observation format or evaluator is unsupported.
